# DynamicParallel

- Namespace/type: `PPDS.Query.Execution.DynamicParallel`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Query`

## Summary

Dynamically scales thread count based on workload when executing multiple plan node partitions in parallel. Replaces the fixed-pool approach of PPDS.Dataverse.Query.Planning.Nodes.ParallelPartitionNode.

Capture source: `a0feb138f00575d35634565f3a733deb9e65ca98`, tree `904cce706d298d3f0ed62ea095bdcdd78d584101` (final-C Release candidate; not a published stable package).
